scope: Ownership of the exact original viewer POST /api/flowchart/pipeline/diff role-policy rejection.

controlled_source_behavior.audit: Both original permission and legacy audit tables retain older rows and append paired durable denied flow.execute rows; repeated real denial is covered. The mutable audit DB is not treated as byte-immutable.
controlled_source_behavior.preload: Only warm current manifest/existing labelsets with original closed read handles and naturally closed maintenance guard can qualify. Original cold initialization still runs and refuses new ownership.

ownership_proof: Identical original denied decision and exact original role-policy rejection frame/closure/return.
Seven distinct real account SQLite transactions with normal commit/context exit and retained closed connections.
First-definition static audit function/code/globals and original class staticmethod/instance attribute identities.
Original forwarded 403 start/terminal response, normal release/completion, no framing/transport error or pending send.
New optional completion inspection errors refuse ownership without replacing the original reply.

refusal_controls: Real audit-trigger rollback propagates its original exception and refuses.
Real terminal-send failure leaves the already committed audit but refuses.
Before-factory and late static audit delegates refuse.
Changed denial binding and malformed optional normalization keep original403 and refuse.
Missing labelsets/legacy manifest preserve original initialization writes but do not get read-only-denial credit.

retention_budget.excess: Refuses only this new ownership lane; original activity/request caps are unchanged.

privacy: No raw bearer/session values, actor/project IDs, request headers/bodies, private absolute paths, data paths or environment values are included. Source filenames are repository-relative provenance.
